name: model-supply-chain
description: Reviews AI/ML model supply chains for security risks including model provenance verification, training data lineage, fine-tuning pipeline integrity, inference dependency review, and backdoor detection. Auto-invoked when reviewing systems that download pre-trained models, fine-tune foundation models, or deploy models from third-party sources. Produces a structured assessment mapped to OWASP LLM03:2025, SLSA v1.0 supply chain levels, and MITRE ATLAS poisoning and supply chain techniques.
